old_value: Q 'Magic Damage' - the sphere E scatters
value_note: Both strings were supplied to the oracle in truncated form; the adjudication is on the substantive claim each string encodes, which is fully checkable against the cached wiki text.

independent_computation.question_restated: For a *derived cast order* scenario, what must the rotation's source line at index 1 assert, and is it the Q damage-row citation (old) or the E-requires-a-Dark-Sphere ordering constraint pinned to a wiki revision (new)?

step_1_what_E_actually_needs.claim: Syndra's E (Scatter the Weak) only produces a stun when it knocks back a pre-existing Dark Sphere; the bare cone is knockback-only.
step_1_what_E_actually_needs.cached_wiki_evidence: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.E[0].effects[0]: "Active: Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and knocks them back for 400 units and up to 800 units away from Syndra based on proximity, though not through terrain." (knockback only, no stun) and effects[1]: "Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast."
step_1_what_E_actually_needs.conclusion: The stun is conditional on a Dark Sphere existing on the ground at E-cast time. That is a genuine *ordering* dependency: a sphere-producing cast must precede E. This is exactly a 'cc_enabler' relation, and it belongs in the rotation's ordering provenance.

step_2_who_supplies_the_sphere.cached_wiki_evidence: Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[0]: "Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds." and Q[0].effects[1]: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2."
step_2_who_supplies_the_sphere.conclusion: Dark Spheres come from Dark Sphere casts. At >= 40 Splinters of Wrath a second stocked charge exists, so a second Dark Sphere cast is a real, separately-schedulable cast.

thresholds_from_cached_wiki.40: Q stocks a 2nd Dark Sphere charge (Q[0].effects[1])
thresholds_from_cached_wiki.60: W deals 12% (+2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage (W[0].effects[3])
thresholds_from_cached_wiki.80: E gains increased scatter angle + 70% slow (E[0].effects[2]) - NOT active at 60
thresholds_from_cached_wiki.100: R execute below 15% max health (R[0].effects[3]) - NOT active at 60
thresholds_from_cached_wiki.120: P Transcendence, +15% AP (P effects) - NOT active at 60

step_3_scenario_consistency_at_60_splint.conclusion: The scenario's splinter value of 60 is >= 40, so the second Dark Sphere charge IS available in this scenario. A dependency naming the second Dark Sphere slot is well-formed here; it would have been ill-formed below 40 splinters. Independent corroboration that the second charge is a first-class rotation slot (not an invented label) comes from data/champion-audit/batch-6.json, which records Syndra's modeled slots as ["P","Q","Q2","W","E","R"] with the note "modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)" and "splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge".

step_4_defect_in_the_old_value.reading_a_as_ordering_provenance: "Q 'Magic Damage'" is a leveling-row citation (data/champions.json Syndra Q[0].leveling attribute is literally "Magic Damage", values 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP)). A damage row states no ordering constraint at all, and the old string carries no revision-pinned source. For a scenario whose whole subject is the *derived order*, sources[1] restating a damage row is non-responsive provenance.
step_4_defect_in_the_old_value.reading_b_as_damage_attribution: If "the sphere E scatters" is read as attributing damage to the scattered sphere, the cached wiki contradicts it outright: a sphere knocked into an enemy deals "Scatter the Weak's damage" (E's row, 60/95/130/165/200 (+60% AP)), not Dark Sphere's row (90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP)). Q's 'Magic Damage' row is the sphere's own on-appearance AoE damage. So under this reading the old value mis-attributes the damage by citing the wrong ability's row - a 1.5x overstatement at rank 1 (90 vs 60 base).
step_4_defect_in_the_old_value.conclusion: Under either reading the old value is wrong or non-responsive.

step_5_check_of_the_new_value.claim_checked: "E requires Q2 (declared cc_enabler)" - i.e. in the derived order, E is placed after a Dark Sphere cast because E's crowd control is sphere-gated.
step_5_check_of_the_new_value.verdict_of_check: Supported by the cached wiki text. E's stun is conditional on a knocked-back Dark Sphere (E[0].effects[1]); spheres are produced by Dark Sphere casts (Q[0].effects[0]); at 60 splinters the second stocked charge (the Q2 slot) is available (Q[0].effects[1], 40-splinter threshold), so naming Q2 as the immediately-preceding sphere-producing cast in the derived order is well-formed and consistent. The 6-second sphere lifetime means a sphere laid earlier in the rotation is still on the ground when E is cast.
step_5_check_of_the_new_value.residual_caveat: The minimal game-rule dependency is 'E needs *a* Dark Sphere on the ground', which one Dark Sphere cast already satisfies; naming the second charge specifically is stricter than the minimal rule. It is not contradicted by the wiki (the second charge conjures an identical Dark Sphere and is available at 60 splinters), and for a derived *order* the enabler that immediately precedes E is the natural citation - so this is a tightness nuance, not a factual error.
step_5_check_of_the_new_value.source_pin: The new value additionally pins a wiki revision (Syndra@4024662). Revision ids in that range are consistent with the repo's other pinned wiki revisions in data/economics-sourced.json (e.g. 'Item group' 4030983 dated 2026-06-17, 'Role Quests' 4026385 dated 2026-06-09), so 4024662 is a plausible mid-2026 Syndra revision. The old value pins nothing.

independent_computation.bottom_line: The correct sources[1] for a derived-order rotation is the CC-enabling ordering constraint - E must follow a Dark Sphere cast, because Scatter the Weak stuns only via a knocked-back Dark Sphere - carried with a revision-pinned wiki quote. That is the new value. The old value cites Q's damage row, which either states no ordering fact or mis-attributes the scattered sphere's damage to Q instead of E.

sources_quoted.quote: Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.
sources_quoted.why: Establishes that E's stun exists only through a knocked-back Dark Sphere, and that the scattered sphere deals *E's* damage, not Q's.

sources_quoted.quote: Active: Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and knocks them back for 400 units and up to 800 units away from Syndra based on proximity, though not through terrain. | Magic Damage: 60/95/130/165/200 (+ 60% AP)
sources_quoted.why: The bare cone is knockback-only - no stun without a sphere - and gives E's own damage row for the mis-attribution check.

sources_quoted.quote: Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds. | Magic Damage: 90/125/160/195/230 (+ 70% AP)
sources_quoted.why: Identifies Q as the sphere producer, the 6s sphere lifetime that keeps the enabler valid across the rotation, and shows Q's 'Magic Damage' row is the on-appearance AoE - not the scattered-sphere hit.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
sources_quoted.why: At the scenario's 60 splinters (>= 40) the second Dark Sphere charge exists, so a Q2 enabler is well-formed for this scenario.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
sources_quoted.why: Confirms the scenario suffix '60' is the Splinters-of-Wrath option value and fixes which Transcendent bonuses are live (40 and 60 yes; 80/100/120 no).

sources_quoted.quote: "modeled": ["P","Q","Q2","W","E","R"] ... "modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)"; gap_summary: "splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge"
sources_quoted.why: Cached corroboration that 'Q2' denotes the second Dark Sphere charge slot, gated by the splinters option - so 'E requires Q2' names a real slot rather than a typo.
Places the cited Syndra revision 4024662 in the repo's own plausible mid-2026 wiki-revision range; the old value pins no revision at all.
